evaluators.description: Routes content based on streaming service availability to prevent redundant downloads

supportedFields.name: streamingServices
supportedFields.description: TMDB provider IDs for streaming services (e.g., [8, 337] for Netflix, Disney+)

streamingServices.name: in
streamingServices.description: Content is available on at least one of these streaming services
streamingServices.valueFormat: Single provider ID or array of TMDB provider IDs, e.g., 8 or [8, 337] for Netflix, Disney+

streamingServices.name: notIn
streamingServices.description: Content is not available on any of these streaming services
streamingServices.valueFormat: Single provider ID or array of TMDB provider IDs, e.g., 8 or [8, 15, 384] for Netflix, Hulu, HBO Max
